output.question: Who is Dow's CTO?
output.answer: Dow Inc.'s chief technology officer is Andre Argenton. He holds a combined role, Chief Technology & Sustainability Officer, which took effect January 1, 2026, and Dow's own leadership page lists him under that title. He took over from A.N. Sreeram, who had been Senior Vice President and CTO. Argenton was previously Dow's Chief Sustainability Officer, and he now also leads the global R&D organization.

key_facts.fact: Dow's corporate leadership page lists Andre Argenton as Chief Technology & Sustainability Officer.
Andre Argenton succeeded A.N. Sreeram as Chief Technology and Sustainability Officer starting January 1, 2026. Dow announced the change on December 29, 2025 and filed an 8-K on January 5, 2026.
Argenton, already Dow's chief sustainability officer, had chief technology officer added to his title, filling the position vacated by A.N. Sreeram.

passages.quote: Andre Argenton will succeed him as Chief Technology and Sustainability Officer starting January 1, 2026.
His title now includes chief technology officer, filling the position vacated by A.N. Sreeram, who retired effective Jan 1.

caveats: Sources disagree on when A.N. Sreeram left. TradingView's summary of the filing says he retires effective June 30, 2026, while Trellis says he retired effective January 1. Both agree that Argenton has held the CTO title since January 1, 2026.
Dow's leadership page has no date, so I can't confirm when it was last updated. It is still current as fetched on 2026-11-11.
This answer is about Dow Inc., the chemical company. It is not about the Dow Jones Industrial Average or Dow Jones & Company, which have no connection to it.
